user.description: System user under which groonga-server-gqtp runs

group.description: System group under which groonga-server-gqtp runs

database.description: Path to the Groonga database file

log_path.description: Path to the main log file

query_log_path.description: Path to the query log file

enable.description: Set to 'no' to disable the groonga daemon (commented out line would be uncommented if disabled)

grn_in_values_too_many_index_match_ratio.description: Threshold ratio for in_values() to fall back to sequential search

grn_between_too_many_index_match_ratio.description: Threshold ratio for between() to fall back to sequential search

grn_mecab_chunked_tokenize_enabled.description: Set to 'yes' to enable chunked tokenize feature (default: no)

grn_mecab_chunk_size_threshold.description: Threshold value for chunk size in chunked tokenize feature
